summary: Verified PersistentPlayer presenter cutout restructure (DOM order + wider container + object-cover object-bottom). Ran Playwright measurements at mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080. All 9 requested acceptance criteria pass on both viewports.

test_results.regression_fallback_no_presenter_image: Code inspection confirms {presenter.image && (...)} guard — cutout not rendered when image empty. Not runtime-tested (no way to force empty state via UI).

critical_code_review_comments: Cutout container extends to left of card (-left-3/-left-4). body has overflow-x:hidden as safety net which is correctly in place; scrollWidth remains clamped at innerWidth on both viewports.

Presenter image is landscape (2048x1151); object-cover object-bottom crops sides — acceptable per spec. Arms visually preserved in screenshot; play button (blue circle, z-10 flex row) renders on top of any horizontal overlap area naturally due to DOM order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PersistentPlayer cutout works on both mobile and desktop with feet flush to card bottom (0px gap), head poking 52px above card, play button remains clickable. Test used data-testid=persistent-player-presenter-cutout and persistent-player-play-btn, scrolled to y=600 then waited up to ~12s for isShowView cycle (opacity>0.5).
rca of the issue: n/a — previous iteration bug (arms cropped / tiny landscape) fixed by (1) reverting to object-cover object-bottom, (2) widening container to w-24/w-36, (3) placing cutout BEFORE flex row in DOM so play button on z-10 flex row naturally stacks above the overlapping cutout area.
